activity_summary: You said the six were in the belt and the rest was locked, and that you would not open either. The list was already wiped. You were in bed by nine, in daylight.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke it once, and did not get up again.

facets.activity: Said where the money was and stayed in bed

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I told her a man goes home
